verdict.rationale: Phaser ships full TypeScript type definitions in its npm package's types folder, and docs note that editors like VS Code auto-detect them for IntelliSense-style completions — satisfying the 'typed API definitions' clause of the story. However, there is no dedicated LSP, and community commentary (phaser-comm-12) characterizes the TypeScript experience as a 'best effort' layer rather than a native first-class implementation, tempering confidence in diagnostics/navigation depth. Missing for 10: no official LSP, no independent hands-on verification of completions/diagnostics/navigation quality, and community skepticism about whether the TS typings are truly first-class vs. best-effort.
